title: Pocketwire Visa Debit Card Engagement Rate Bulletin: Charity Card-Activity Lift in Pocketwire Rewards
content:
Pocketwire Rewards values donated points at a higher rate for members who made at least 12 settled purchases on their Pocketwire Visa Debit Cards over the last three months.

## Rule

The charity card-activity lift is 0.05 cents per point when the member's debit cards carry at least 30 settled purchases dated within the last three months, 0.02 cents per point when they carry at least 12 but fewer than 30, and nothing when they carry fewer than 12.

The lift is added to the charity rate per point before the rate is applied to the points donated.

The purchases counted are the settled purchase entries on the ledgers of all of the member's Pocketwire Visa Debit Cards. A date lies within the last three months when it is later than the same calendar day three months before the handling date and not later than the handling date.

## Count and lift

| Settled card purchases within the last three months | Lift (cents per point) |
|---|---|
| 30 or more | 0.05 |
| 12 to 29 | 0.02 |
| 11 or fewer | nothing |

## Boundary cases

- 30 purchases: 0.05; 29: 0.02.
- 12 purchases: 0.02; 11: nothing.
